label: Miniature Diorama
intent: Narrative space, exhibition thinking, and a path toward motion or interaction
path_treatment: Build the visual path as a continuous physical channel with believable miniature depth.
form_treatment: Translate key forms into simplified hand-built model components and one detailed focal miniature.
space_treatment: Expose gaps and a tabletop base so the result reads as a crafted maquette, not a full-size scene.
composition: Gentle elevated three-quarter view with a complete irregular base and legible spatial journey.
